state-write.sh's --audit-verdict flag could not accept the full task-proposals-audit.ndjson directly: each of its two ~151KB lines exceeds Linux's per-argv MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128KB), since the script passes the file's parsed JSON as a single --argjson shell argument ('Argument list too long', exit 126). Worked around by building a condensed audit-verdict file (scratchpad: condensed-audit.ndjson) that keeps every non-scope-blind verdict verbatim and replaces the ~450-490 scope-blind entries per proposal with a 'scope_blind_count' integer -- exactly the compact rendering the plan's Phase 2 step already called for. The full, uncondensed task-proposals-audit.ndjson remains the durable committed evidence; the condensed file is only state-write.sh's --audit-verdict input and is recorded verbatim into each new entry's own audit_verdict field.
